identity_rotated.description: Announce an identity signing-key rotation. Sent by the OLD identity over each active relationship before the local identity switches; the receiver verifies both cross-signatures against the pinned peer identity id, then updates the stored peer identity. The new_card is a full agent card (see agent-card.schema.json); the schema here requires its identity-bearing fields and lets verify_card enforce the rest.

cross_signatures.description: Exactly two cross-signatures over the restricted-JCS bytes of new_card: one by the old identity key, one by the new.

key_id.description: Signer identity id, multibase base58btc Ed25519 public key.

new_card.description: The replacement agent card, signed by the new identity key.

identity_id.description: New identity id, multibase base58btc Ed25519 public key.

prior_card_fingerprint.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical old card the rotation supersedes.

description: Identity payloads: identity.rotated. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
